plugin.name: enclave-mark
plugin._long: Draws a frame around every window whose client connected through a security-context-v1 socket, coloured per sandbox instance. Needs the security-context-v1 plugin.

option.name: label
option._long: Show the instance name on a tab right-aligned on the frame's top edge, above the window, in the frame colour.

option.name: label_size
option._long: Font size of the name tab, in logical pixels.

option.name: colors
option._long: Comma-separated instance=colour pairs, keyed by the security context's instance_id. A colour is "r g b a" floats or an ESCAPED hex \#RRGGBBAA (an unescaped # starts an ini comment). An instance not listed gets a stable colour hashed from its name.
